claims.claim: Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and Embroidery Machine
claims.evidence: Brand 'brother' is visible in both photos, but the model number SE630 is not legible in any shot; small text near the screen is too blurry to confirm.
Screen shows a floral/thread graphic consistent with embroidery capability, but no stitch-out sample or functional test is shown.

risks.risk: Model identity unconfirmed (could be a cheaper Brother model, not SE630)
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo or video of the model nameplate/label, usually on the back or side of the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/base-model Brother sewing machine, not as SE630

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly
risks.proof: Video of machine powering on, screen navigating menus, and a test stitch being sewn

risks.risk: Missing accessories (foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, needles, embroidery hoops, manual)
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage or wear (back/underside not shown)
risks.proof: Photos of the back, underside, and close-ups of any scratches or cracks
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming moderate cosmetic wear, worst case until shown otherwise

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history (could be heavily used or refurbished)
risks.proof: Photo of serial number/date code or original purchase receipt
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/older unit, no premium for 'like new' condition

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model number/nameplate
Video of the machine powering on and completing a test stitch
Photo of all included accessories (pedal, cord, bobbins, needles, hoops, manual)
Photos of the back and underside of the machine
Photo of any serial number or date label
response.reason: The witness confirms a Brother sewing/embroidery machine, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified base model with no confirmed accessories or functionality, pending the listed proofs to justify the SE630 claim and a higher price.
